breakingChanges.summary: Ktor 3.0 applies cookie security prefixes (__Secure-/__Host-) automatically; names containing them must be stripped or the cookie is double-prefixed and rejected by browsers
breakingChanges.detail: In Ktor 3.0 the response cookie encoder applies the __Secure- and __Host- prefixes automatically when the cookie is configured with secure=true. Cookie names that still embed the literal __Secure- prefix are now double-prefixed at runtime (e.g. __Secure-__Secure-ws_session), which Chrome and Firefox reject outright, breaking authenticated sessions. The literal prefix MUST be removed from the cookie name during the 3.0 upgrade; the framework re-applies it on the wire.

migrationSteps.instruction: In grid/api/src/main/kotlin/com/bliss/grid/api/routes/PuzzleRoute.kt, change SESSION_COOKIE_NAME from "__Secure-ws_session" to "ws_session". Ktor 3.0 adds the __Secure- prefix automatically for secure cookies; keeping the literal prefix double-prefixes the cookie and browsers reject it.
